messages:
nina_docs: Heads-up team 1: I'm putting together a pragmatic migration doc for v1 -> v2 (API + SDK) that focuses on what breaks and quick fixes. Need volunteers for: API reference banner copy, code snippet replacements (JS/Py/Ruby), embed-vector reindex example, and a short note about Dedicated opt-in.

ryan_sdk: I can do JS + Ruby snippets and the short SDK 'what changed' bullet. Prefer to use new param `model_id` everywhere in examples. Also will add a tiny compatibility helper for legacy callers.

samuel_infra: Infra note: we won't auto-upgrade runtime behavior for v1 clients. There will be a compat helper available for simple non-streaming requests but it won't support some streaming frames or custom knobs. We'll call that out.

kate_prod: Product updates: hosted will flip default models next Wednesday at 16:00 UTC; Dedicated customers can opt into the v2 pool during a 14-day window. Docs MUST call out: (1) timing, (2) how to opt in, (3) fallback behavior.

mike_qa: QA will own smoke suite. Add me to PRs. I'll add a test matrix: quick generation, streaming, embeddings, and reindex end-to-end for pgvector. I'll also paste a short reindex script example in the doc.

nina_docs: Plan draft:
- Banner copy for API reference (2 variants: mild, firm)
- Migration guide sections: summary, code migration, streaming differences, embed compatibility, rollout timeline, FAQ
- Snippets: small inline examples (keep each <6 lines) + one sample app PR link

ryan_sdk: Draft SDK note: "Breaking changes: param rename `model` -> `model_id`; stricter streaming validation; embed vector dims may change for some models. Update tests and CI to validate streaming behavior." I'll attach example old vs new.

nina_docs: Please keep example concise, e.g.:
```
// v1
client.generate({ model: 'redwood/v1-lite', prompt: 'hey' })

// v2
client.generate({ model_id: 'redwood/v2-efficiency', prompt: 'hey' })
```

ryan_sdk: I'll add Ruby too:```rb
# v2
client.generate(model_id: 'redwood/v2-efficiency', prompt: 'hello')
```

samuel_infra: Compat helper example (short):
```py
# translate legacy call -> v2 minimal
if 'model' in req: req['model_id'] = req.pop('model')
# NOTE: streaming semantics differ; this only covers basic sync calls
```

mike_qa: Reindex pseudo-command to include in embed section:```sh
python tools/reindex_vectors.py --src-index legacy_idx --dst-index v2_idx --model redwood/v2-embed-xl
# run downstream vector store migration (pgvector example in notes)
```

kate_prod: FAQ asks: will API keys break? No. Will latency change? Possibly for some models; include link to model catalog perf profiles. Should we include a small perf-blurb table? Keep it simple: "v2 may have lower latency for medium-length prompts; check model page."

nina_docs: Banner wording (mild): "Notice: v1 API endpoints are on the deprecation path. See our migration guide for details and example snippets." (firm): "Deprecated: v1 endpoints will be retired; migrate to v2. See migration guide." Thoughts?

ryan_sdk: Use the mild banner on reference pages; reserve the firm message for the deprecation timeline page. Also add a small link to the SDK changelog entry.

samuel_infra: CI note: when PR lands, infra will run smoke tests and a limited canary rollout to the staging docs site. We'll report any snippet failures.

ci-bot: CI scheduled: branch `docs/migrate/v1-v2` will run lint + smoke tests at 2024-11-05T14:30:00Z.

mike_qa: I'll create a checklist entry for smoke runs: verify sample app builds, run streaming client test harness, run reindex script against test pgvector instance. Post results as comment on the PR.

nina_docs: Owners + deadlines:
- ryan_sdk: snippets (JS/Ruby) + SDK blurb (due EOD tomorrow)
- samuel_infra: compat helper + infra note (due Mon)
- mike_qa: smoke plan + reindex example (due Mon)
- nina_docs: assemble draft, add banners, publish PR (due Tue AM)

ryan_sdk: I'll link to existing sample app repo to reuse the small generation example.

kate_prod: I'll prepare the opt-in instructions for Dedicated (how to request opt-in via console + support flow).

nina_docs: Great. Final ask: please avoid long multi-file snippets in the doc; keep them copy-paste friendly. I'll ping #docs-review when PR is ready. :rocket:
